title: Lawn Bowls
tagline: Read the green, pick a hand, bend the bowl in to the jack.
description: Lawn bowls from above on a striped club green: place the ring, choose which way the bowl leans and how hard it goes, and watch it curve in toward the jack. Five greens, six rivals, a club ladder and pass-and-play for two.
howToPlay: Press the green to place the gold ring where you want the bowl to finish.
Tap Curve left or Curve right: every bowl bends toward its small-ring side.
Choose Draw, Firm or Drive for how hard it arrives, then press Roll.
Bowls alternate, four each. After eight, the side nearer the jack scores a shot per bowl.
Play 6 or 10 ends; most shots wins.
